title: Saying Goodbye to Expensive Tokens: AI Company Writer Launches Palmyra X6 and Architecture Upgrade, Aiming to Cut Usage Costs in Half

content_html:
As enterprises become increasingly sensitive to the costs of AI deployment, the market's demand for cost reduction has also become more urgent. While open-source models can significantly reduce the cost per token, it is often not easy to accurately select the most suitable option from a large number of models.

To address this industry pain point, Writer, a company providing AI tools and agents for marketers, officially launched its new flagship model Palmyra X6 on Thursday. This model is a deeply fine-tuned version of Z.ai's open-source model GLM-5.2, aiming to provide users with a high-value solution that is ready for direct deployment. Writer's official estimates suggest that by combining the new model with an upgraded large model calling framework, the cost of basic tasks could be reduced by up to 50%.

At the same time as launching the new model, Writer also made significant upgrades to its standard agent calling framework and has been fully available to customers since Thursday. Writer's CEO May Habib pointed out that enterprise customers are tired of endlessly chasing benchmark scores and are truly seeking stable and controllable cost expenditures, which few labs currently fulfill.

The new technical solution focuses on efficiently handling multi-step complex tasks, aiming to reduce token consumption while improving processing speed. A recent paper released by Writer researchers also supports this approach: they conducted fine-tuning tests on the framework efficiency across multiple different models, and the results showed that an optimized framework often provides greater cost-effectiveness than simply replacing the model, with an average overall cost reduction of about 40% in the tests.

Although the newly launched Palmyra X6 still maintains the characteristic of model neutrality, allowing it to work collaboratively with Writer's other products or external models introduced through Azure and Amazon Bedrock, the current situation of rising costs is causing chief information officers of enterprises to lose trust in major AI laboratories. Habib believes that existing AI laboratories still have a long way to go in helping enterprises achieve real benefits through artificial intelligence.

content_html_zh:
随着企业对AI部署成本越来越敏感，市场对降低成本的需求也变得更加迫切。 虽然开源模型可以显着降低每个代币的成本，但从大量模型中准确选择最合适的选项通常并不容易。

针对这一行业痛点，为营销人员提供AI工具和代理的Writer公司于周四正式推出了新旗舰机型Palmyra X6。 该模型是Z.ai开源模型GLM-5.2的深度微调版本，旨在为用户提供可直接部署的高价值解决方案。 Writer官方预估，通过将新模型与升级后的大模型调用框架相结合，基础任务的成本最多可降低50%。

在推出新模式的同时，Writer还对其标准座席呼叫框架进行了重大升级，并于周四起全面向客户提供。 Writer首席执行官May Habib指出，企业客户已经厌倦了无休止地追逐基准分数，真正寻求稳定可控的成本支出，而目前很少有实验室能够做到这一点。

新技术解决方案专注于高效处理多步骤复杂任务，旨在减少代币消耗，同时提高处理速度。 Writer研究人员最近发布的一篇论文也支持了这种做法：他们对多个不同模型的框架效率进行了微调测试，结果表明，优化后的框架往往比简单替换模型具有更大的成本效益，测试中平均总体成本降低约40%。

尽管新推出的Palmyra X6仍然保持了模型中立的特点，可以与Writer的其他产品或通过Azure和Amazon Bedrock引入的外部模型协同工作，但成本上涨的现状正在导致企业首席信息官对各大AI实验室失去信任。 哈比卜认为，现有的人工智能实验室在帮助企业通过人工智能实现真正的效益方面还有很长的路要走。
